model.directions: Axial wavevector azimuth [0,180), clockwise from CRS north; not stripe/feature strike.
model.padding: Zero padding at array origin to next power of two per axis; no mirror extension.
model.bin_edges: Scaled indices within1e-10 of an integer snap to it; last radial edge included; direction180 wraps to0.

assumptions: Explicit linear projected/local rectangular geometry and selected-band units required. Mean/plane removal precedes windowing. Missing selected-band cells require an explicitly complete region; no gap filling.
Full two-sided DFT power is counted once, without additional doubling. DC and corner frequencies outside the conservative radial support are reported separately.
Summed bin power equals sum(residual^2*window^2)/sum(window^2); density is per two-dimensional map-frequency area. Radial mean density is not a one-dimensional annular PSD or amplitude estimate.
Direction is wavevector variation direction, generally orthogonal to ideal stripe/elongation strike; no automatic flight direction or geology/noise assignment.
Windowing and region selection alter spectra. Zero padding interpolates frequency samples; it does not create independent observations or physical resolving power. Empty bins have null mean density.
The reported numerical amplitude floor is diagnostic only: weak energy is retained, not thresholded. Source uncertainty is archived without propagation or confidence intervals.
Spectra do not determine noise, geological depth or mineralisation uniquely, and do not choose filter cutoffs. Compare explicit processing choices and independent evidence.
